acceptance_scope: Accept the architecture decision and feasibility-study layer as consistent with the reviewed A0-A8 contracts. This does not close the ten qualification blockers, accept a concrete compressor/runtime, or resume individual kernel design.
review_method: Read repository working instructions and relevant README/PROJECT_STATE entries, prior requirements/interfaces/receipt, new four-file packet and A0/A4-A8 dependencies.
Compared all ten requirement IDs and acceptance boundaries; checked all qualification states remain open.

Adversarial review of prior ancestry, computational support versus physical support, synthetic aging restrictions, error semantics, useful availability, reset and all-in resource gates. S1 and S2 individual proof reviews are separate acceptance dependencies.
Final metadata-only resolution status change inspected: architecture_status=specified; review acceptance remains in a separate receipt. Final current resolution hash bound.

findings.finding: No blocker disappears: all ten prior IDs have explicit architecture choices, residual evidence and acceptance boundaries. Parameterized device inputs resolve API responsibilities without inventing device constants.
findings.qualification: Describe completion as architecture decisions specified, not all requirements empirically resolved.

findings.finding: The prior-free EvidenceObject is preserved. BoundaryMessage explicitly includes the original prior and ancestor prefix; TransitionEvidence owns a new disjoint interval. Reusing a posterior with ancestor evidence is forbidden. S1 explicitly requires sufficient sensor/path memory and does not claim finite closure.

The computational box, log coordinates, rate probes and sparse encodings do not redefine allowable batteries. Original prior tails stay explicit, omitted mass requires accounting, full-domain/migration evidence is required and the known 35520-sample box exit remains mandatory.

Continuous SOC/RC-voltage/hysteresis states and ordered physical branches are explicit synthetic-profile choices. They do not claim charge-conserving physical aging, arbitrary pole crossings, H/gamma evolution or arbitrary monotone-path closure. Real aging acceptance remains blocked.

Remaining-margin error budgeting is a concrete conservative acceptance rule compatible with A5/A6; no fabricated NLL or per-module threshold is needed at this semantic stage. Local precision, model fidelity, physical containment and availability remain distinct. Unknown errors cannot consume a fictitious finite margin.

Single-writer/immutable-publication semantics, bounded queues, aged-cell reset support and authority revocation match A4/A8. All-in SRAM and conditional CPU ceilings retain stack/ISR, transaction, migration and useful-service obligations; target deployment is not implied.

remaining_blockers.boundary: Before selecting or accepting approximate individual blocks
items: Freeze public stationary domain, original prior/measure, sensor weights and common queries independently of fitted truth.
Establish candidate uniform joint likelihood/transport/derivative and numerical bounds, PSD treatment, full-support or omitted-mass accounting, and sustainable ten-year query margins.
Derive update state, migration/recovery information and all simultaneously live resources; coefficient bytes alone do not establish closure or feasibility.

remaining_blockers.boundary: Before accepting aging or uncertain-input history
items: Specify and qualify transition family, state convention, H/gamma evolution, input/calibration memory and sufficient boundary separator.
Re-derive stationary A0 dependencies for any extension; test equal-final-health/different-path and correlated-sensor witnesses.

remaining_blockers.boundary: Before physical authorization or unattended useful-service claims
items: Characterize physical/sensor/ADC/input/clock bounds or probability laws and actual cell support.
Freeze full load policy, fallback, risk/reset semantics, achievable scenario law, useful-query deadlines and outage objectives before confirmation.
Bind maximum sample rate, useful CPU allocation, fault/interrupt/reset/integrity models and counter operation envelopes.
Produce complete layout/link/stack/ISR, target service/backlog/deadline and containment evidence within 10240 bytes.
Obtain independent acceptance of S1 and S2 at the recorded hashes; substantively revised packets require renewed independent review.

limits: Review covers the recorded specification hashes, not future edits or an implementation.
No physical characterization, numerical closure, calibrated coverage, target measurement or ten-year experiment performed.
Acceptance does not certify the whole user objective as finished if it is interpreted to require empirical feasibility or binding device-owner inputs.
